question: To whom is the determination of Raktapāla said to apply, described as delighting in the practice of yoga?
premises: Those delighting in the practice of yoga are brought into view.
That determination is directed to them.
inference: The determination of Raktapāla applies indeed to those delighting in the practice of yoga.
uncertainties: The content of the determination is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Indeed, to those delighting in the practice of yoga belongs the determination of Raktapāla.
